topic: Identify the Baroque composer of the Brandenburg Concertos
core_question: Who composed the set of orchestral works known as the Brandenburg Concertos?
answer_summary: Johann Sebastian Bach, the German Baroque composer who wrote the Brandenburg Concertos.
